Landmark: Close to Radisson Blu Hotel

Open in Google Maps ↗ Call coordinator

For out-station guests

  • If you're traveling from Dhaka, you can book a ticket on the Subarna Express or the Sonar Bangla Express to Chittagong Station.
  • The venue is just a 10 to 15-minute rickshaw ride from the station premises.
  • Train tickets are very scarce; you may need to book 10 days in advance of your journey date.
  • Please do not hesitate to contact the coordinator for any assistance.

Reception

15 December

Tiger Garden Int. Hotel, Khulna, Bangladesh

Landmark: Close to Shibbari more

Parking: Available on-site

Open in Google Maps ↗ Call coordinator

For out-station guests

  • Taking a bus is the most convenient way to travel from Dhaka or Chittagong to Khulna.
  • Sonadanga is the nearest bus terminal to the venue.
  • It takes about 10 minutes to get from Sonadanga to the venue.
  • Book your tickets in advance to avoid last-minute hassles.
  • If you don't prefer to take a bus, you can take a train to Khulna station (Jahanabad Express from Dhaka) and then a rickshaw(around 10 minutes) to the venue.
  • Please do not hesitate to contact the coordinator for any assistance.

Frequently Asked

Are children welcome?

Yes! Kids' corner with snacks & activities at the reception. Mention them in your RSVP.

Can I bring a plus-one?

Absolutely — please add them to your RSVP party size.

What should I wear?

Wedding day: traditional Bengali (saree / panjabi). Reception: no dress code. Comfort over couture.

How do I travel between Chittagong and Khulna?

Easiest: fly Chittagong → Dhaka → Jessore (JSR), then 30-min drive to Khulna. Train: Chitra Express / Sundarban Express overnight.

Gifts?

While your presence is the greatest gift of all, if you would like to bring something anyway, please keep in mind that we will be moving abroad next year. We would be very heartbroken if we couldn't take your gift with us.
